$comment: Real jobs: tasks a person does with this app, each with an outcome a check can observe. Keyed by job id so scripts/merge-json merges two PRs that add different jobs. scripts/jobs check validates every field; jobs.md beside this file is generated from it on dev (scripts/jobs render), never edited. The fields and the done rule: docs/factory/packets.md, Jobs.

RJ-H01.job: Make a lower third: a bar slides in, the name is revealed through a mask, holds 4 s, slides out.
RJ-H01.outcome: Render ProRes 4444 with alpha that keys over video in an editor.
RJ-H01.trap: Background comes out black (the movie writer fills black at alpha 1)

RJ-H02.job: Make a logo reveal: the logo scales up with an overshoot ease and fades in over 5 s; render H.264 1080p.
RJ-H02.outcome: The logo layer scales with an overshoot and fades in over 5 s, in a 1080p H.264 movie.
RJ-H02.needs_note: built keys/easing; S20 and E11 through halo/placed-images (a PNG or SVG picture in a solid)
RJ-H02.trap: No image or SVG layer, so the logo can't come in

RJ-H03.job: Make kinetic type: five words pop in on the beat with a stagger.
RJ-H03.outcome: The five words appear one after another on the beat from one text layer, with an even stagger.
RJ-H03.trap: One layer per word by hand; no stagger

RJ-H04.job: Set a title card with a chosen font, weight, tracking and two lines.
RJ-H04.outcome: The title shows two lines in the chosen font, weight and tracking, in the viewer and the render.

RJ-H05.job: Render a 1080×1080, 15 s social clip under 15 MB.
RJ-H05.outcome: Size and duration exact, plays in QuickTime.
RJ-H05.trap: No bitrate or size readout; 1081 px rounds to 1080 silently

RJ-H06.outcome: The movie is exactly 1080 wide by 1920 high.
RJ-H06.trap: Width and height swapped by the preset

RJ-H07.job: Export a GIF of the comp for a chat app.
RJ-H07.outcome: A GIF file of the comp at its size and length, looping.

RJ-H08.job: Precompose three layers and reuse the precomp three times; edit once, all update.
RJ-H08.outcome: One edit inside the precomp shows in all three uses, in the viewer and the render.

RJ-H09.job: Fill text with a moving gradient through a track matte.
RJ-H09.outcome: The text is filled with the moving gradient and nothing outside the text shows, in the render.
RJ-H09.trap: Matte inverted or ignored in render

RJ-H10.job: Parent five layers to a null and move the group.
RJ-H10.outcome: The five layers keep their positions when parented and move together with the null.

RJ-H11.job: Apply ease-in-out presets to position keys.
RJ-H11.outcome: The motion slows at both ends.

RJ-H12.job: Shape a speed curve in the graph editor.
RJ-H12.outcome: The speed curve shaped in the graph editor is the motion the render shows.

RJ-H13.job: Select several keys across layers and drag them later in time.
RJ-H13.outcome: Every selected key moves by the same time offset, hidden layers' keys included.
RJ-H13.needs_note: S16 (SuiteUI timeline built); halo/key-editing wires picking across lanes, Select All Keys and the key drag into Halo
RJ-H13.trap: Keys of hidden layers stay behind

RJ-H14.job: Set a work area of 2 to 5 s and render only that.
RJ-H14.outcome: The render is exactly 3 s long and starts at the 2 s frame.

RJ-H15.job: Drop in a music track, see its waveform, key to the beat, render with audio.
RJ-H15.outcome: The render has an audio track in sync with the keyed beats.

RJ-H16.job: Import a video clip and an image as layers and scale them to fit.
RJ-H16.outcome: The clip and the image are layers scaled to fit the comp, and both show in the render.

RJ-H17.job: Add blur and glow to a title and change them later.
RJ-H17.outcome: The blur and glow stay editable, and the render shows their current settings.
RJ-H17.trap: Effects baked or missing in render

RJ-H18.job: Colour-correct footage with a Curves adjustment layer.
RJ-H18.outcome: A Curves adjustment layer changes the footage below it in the viewer and the render, and stays editable.

RJ-H19.job: Add a wiggle to a layer's position without keying each frame.
RJ-H19.outcome: The position wiggles without keys, and the preview and the render show the same motion.
RJ-H19.needs_note: none: behaviours are only a buffer in the beta-80 plan
RJ-H19.trap: Random differs between preview and render

RJ-H20.job: Centre layers in the comp and check title-safe guides.
RJ-H20.outcome: The layers sit on the comp centre and inside the title-safe guides.

RJ-H21.job: Rotate and scale a layer with handles in the viewer.
RJ-H21.outcome: Dragging the handles rotates and scales the layer, not only moves it.

RJ-H22.trap: Random seeds or float drift change frames

RJ-H23.job: Force-quit after 30 minutes of work, relaunch.
RJ-H23.trap: Work lost since the last save

RJ-H24.job: Scrub a 10-minute comp with 200 layers and render it.
RJ-H24.outcome: Scrubbing stays smooth; memory doesn't grow over the render.

RJ-H25.outcome: No partial movie or stray frames are left behind.
RJ-H25.trap: Half-written .mov left in the folder: unverified

RJ-H26.job: Render a PNG sequence with alpha.
RJ-H26.outcome: Edges are clean over any background.

RJ-H27.job: Export a simple shape animation as Lottie.
RJ-H27.outcome: Plays the same in a standard player.

RJ-H28.job: Make 50 key edits including scrubs, then undo all.
RJ-H28.trap: Each scrub frame becomes a step

RJ-H29.job: Hide, lock and solo layers while working.
RJ-H29.outcome: Hidden layers don't draw, locked layers don't move, and solo changes only the viewer, never the render.

RJ-H30.job: Draw a star shape with a gradient fill and a stroke.
RJ-H30.outcome: A star shape with a gradient fill and a stroke, in the viewer and the render.
RJ-H30.needs_note: S19 star, S24 gradient, S17 stroke; the stroke adopt lands last
RJ-H30.trap: Rectangles and ellipses only, layer colour only

RJ-H31.job: Animate a bar chart from a CSV of five values.
RJ-H31.outcome: Five bars whose heights match the CSV's values, animated in.

RJ-H32.job: Give a solid layer a radial gradient, white at the centre to black at the edge, and render frame 0.
RJ-H32.outcome: In the rendered PNG the layer's centre pixel is within 2/255 of white and its corner within 2/255 of black, and the viewer's frame has the same pixels.
RJ-H32.trap: The viewer draws the gradient but the render path still fills the layer's old solid colour

RJ-H33.job: Make 10 position keys, jump back to the fourth in History, save and reopen.
RJ-H33.outcome: The reopened layer has the first four keys with their values and easings.
RJ-H33.trap: The jump records a step, or replays from the save and drops easings

RJ-H34.job: Key a 30 degree turn and a 2x scale at frame 12 by command on a layer with rotation animated.
RJ-H34.outcome: The rotation track has a key of 30 at frame 12 with its base kept, the scale keys 2 there, and the layer's centre is unchanged.
RJ-H34.trap: The turn overwrites the base value instead of keying, or the scale moves the layer

RJ-H35.job: Draw a six-point star shape layer by command and render frame 0.
RJ-H35.outcome: The frame shows a star: the top point is the layer colour and the rim between two outer points is not.
RJ-H35.trap: The renderer ignores the spec and draws an ellipse

RJ-H36.job: Place a two-colour PNG logo into a composition by command and render frame 0.
RJ-H36.outcome: In the rendered PNG the logo's left half is red and its right half blue within 2/255, centred at its own 200 x 100 size, and the pixels just outside it are the background.
RJ-H36.trap: The viewer shows the logo but the render draws the solid's colour, or the logo is stretched to the composition

RJ-H41.job: Render a lower third as ProRes 4444 with a transparent background.
RJ-H41.outcome: The movie is ProRes 4444 with alpha: a background-only pixel has alpha 0, a bar pixel alpha 255.
RJ-H41.trap: Alpha renders black, or the file says ProRes but carries no alpha

RJ-H42.job: Reopen a project from Open Recent and drop a .halo and a PNG on Halo.
RJ-H42.outcome: Open Recent equals the suite list filtered to Halo; the .halo opens and the PNG goes to Photo.
RJ-H42.trap: Halo keeps its own list, or an image drop is silently ignored

RJ-H43.job: Give a title an outer glow whose size is keyed from 0 to 20 over one second, and render frames 0, 15 and 30.
RJ-H43.outcome: The glow reaches 0 px past the title at frame 0, 20 px at frame 30 and an eased value between at frame 15.
RJ-H43.trap: The glow is baked at one size for every frame, or the keys show in the viewer but not in the render

RJ-H70.job: Change a 10 s composition to 15 s with a navy background, then render frame 400.
RJ-H70.outcome: Frame 400 renders with a navy corner within 2 levels and the keys stay at frames 30 and 270.
RJ-H70.trap: The comp can't be changed without rebuilding it, or the keys stretch to the new length

RJ-H50.job: Blur a title layer by 6 px, then change the blur to 2 px later and render a frame.
RJ-H50.outcome: The frame equals a single radius-2 blur of the title within 1 level; the project holds one filter on the layer.
RJ-H50.trap: The second edit adds a second blur instead of changing the first

RJ-H51.job: Stagger three words by sliding the second layer 6 frames and the third 12 frames later, then trim the third's end by 12 frames.
RJ-H51.outcome: At frame 18 the second word's opacity equals the original's at frame 12 within 1%; the third word's out point is 12 frames earlier and its keys moved by 12.
RJ-H51.trap: A slide moves the bar but leaves the keys behind, so the word pops in early
